field.name: tk_ts

field.name: tk_kh
field.aliasName: isnull(case when d.tk_kh='' then a.tk_du else d.tk_kh end, a.tk_du)

field.name: gt_kh_ky_nt
field.aliasName: case when isnull(d.so_ky_kh, 0) = 0 then 0 else a.tien_nt/d.so_ky_kh end

field.name: gt_kh_ky
field.aliasName: case when isnull(d.so_ky_kh, 0) = 0 then 0 else a.tien/d.so_ky_kh end

declare @departmentCode varchar(32) = '', @departmentName nvarchar(128) = '', @currencyName nvarchar(128) = '' select top 1 @departmentCode = @ma_bp, @departmentName = ten_bp%l from dmbpcc where ma_bp = @ma_bp if @departmentCode = '' select @departmentCode = @ma_bp_ex, @departmentName = @ten_bp_ex select @currencyName = ten_nt%l from dmnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt
if exists(select 1 from dmttndcc where ma_pl_cc = @ma_pl_cc and status = '1') begin select '' as array$, &Fields.Data.Client.Alias; from dmttndcc a with(nolock) join dmploaicc z with(nolock) on a.ma_pl_cc = z.ma_pl left join dmplcc b with(nolock) on a.loai_ts = b.ma_loai left join dmtgcc c with(nolock) on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmphi f with(nolock) on a.ma_phi = f.ma_phi left join dmnv g with(nolock) on a.ma_nv = g.ma_nv left join dmtk h with(nolock) on a.tk_kh = h.tk where a.ma_pl_cc = @ma_pl_cc and a.status = '1' return end else begin select '' as array$, &Fields.Data.Client.Alias.Empty; return end

query.text:
&CheckRelativeProcess;
declare @c char(1), @d char(1), @q nvarchar(4000), @key nvarchar(4000) = '' select @c = char(253), @d = char(252) select * into #t from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@@queryString, @c) declare @customer varchar(128), @voucherCode char(3), @dateFrom smalldatetime, @dateTo smalldatetime, @unitCode varchar(8000), @groupBy char(1), @idNumber char(13) = ''
select @dateFrom = data from #t where id = 1 select @dateTo = data from #t where id = 2 select @voucherCode = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 3 select @customer = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 4 select @unitCode = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 5 select @groupBy = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 6 select @idNumber = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 7
if @unitCode = '' set @unitCode = @@unit
-- select top 0 identity (int, 1, 1) as id, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, cast(null as nvarchar(4000)) as ten_vt, cast(null as varchar(32)) as ma_pl_cc, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv into #d from d84$000000 a right join (select top 0 null a) b on 1 = 0 select top 0 identity (int, 1, 1) as line_nbr, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_vt, cast(null as nvarchar(4000)) as ten_vt, cast(null as varchar(32)) as ma_pl_cc, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv into #detail from d84$000000 a right join (select top 0 null a) b on 1 = 0
declare @queryWhereClause nvarchar(4000), @queryFormClause nvarchar(4000), @$table varchar(32), @$status char(1), @r nvarchar(4000), @rq tinyint, @field varchar(4000) = '' declare @i int, @n int, @n2 int, @ma_bp varchar(32) select @$table = case when @voucherCode = 'PXA' then '84' else '78' end, @$status = case when @voucherCode = 'PXA' then '3' else '2' end select @rq = cast(val as tinyint) from options where lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'
select @r = 'insert into #d' if @groupBy = '0' begin select @field = 'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, ' + case when @@language = 'V' then 'b.ten_vt' else 'b.ten_vt2' end + ', b.ma_pl_cc, b.dvt, round(a.he_so * a.so_luong, ' + rtrim(@rq) + ')' if @voucherCode = 'PXA' select @field = @field + ', a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv' else select @field = @field + ', case when c.ma_nt = '''' then c.tien_xuat else c.tien_nt_x end, c.tien_xuat, a.tk_cpxt, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv' end else begin select @field = 'max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.so_ct), a.stt_rec, max(a.stt_rec0), max(a.line_nbr), a.ma_vt, ' + case when @@language = 'V' then 'max(b.ten_vt)' else 'max(b.ten_vt2)' end + ', max(b.ma_pl_cc), max(b.dvt), sum(round(a.he_so * a.so_luong, ' + rtrim(@rq) + '))' if @voucherCode = 'PXA' select @field = @field + ', sum(a.tien_nt), sum(a.tien), max(a.tk_du), max(a.tk_vt), max(a.ma_bp), max(a.ma_bp) as ma_bp_gl, max(a.ma_kho), max(a.ma_vv)' else select @field = @field + ', case when max(c.ma_nt) = '''' then sum(tien_xuat) else sum(c.tien_nt_x) end, sum(c.tien_xuat), max(a.tk_cpxt), max(a.tk_vt), max(a.ma_bp), max(a.ma_bp) as ma_bp_gl, max(a.ma_kho), max(a.ma_vv)' end select @r = @r + ' select ' + @field select @r = @r + ' from d' + @$table + '$%Partition a join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and b.loai_vt = ''31'' and a.so_luong > 0' select @r = @r + case when @voucherCode = 'PXA' then '' else ' join r70$%Partition c on (left(a.stt_rec, 10) + ''PXG'') = c.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec0' end
if isnull(@idNumber, '') <> '' select @key = case when @key = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' a.stt_rec = ''' + replace(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + '''' if exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID) begin select @key = @key + case when @key = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID and a.ma_kho = r.ma_kho)' end if @key <> '' select @r = @r + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
if @groupBy <> '0' begin select @r = @r + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_vt' + case when @groupBy = '2' then ', a.ma_bp' when @groupBy = '3' then ', a.ma_vv' when @groupBy = '4' then ', a.ma_bp, a.ma_vv' else '' end end
exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @r, null, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @@userID, @@admin
insert into #detail select ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ten_vt, ma_pl_cc, dvt, so_luong, tien_nt, tien, tk_du, tk_vt, ma_bp, ma_bp_gl, ma_kho, ma_vv from #d order by stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr
-- Get department update #detail set ma_bp = b.ma_bp from #detail a join dmbpcc b on a.ma_bp_gl = b.ma_bp0 where b.status = 1 and a.ma_bp_gl <> ''
select @queryFormClause = 'm' + @$table + '$%Partition m with(nolock) join #detail a on m.stt_rec = a.stt_rec left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmttndcc d on a.ma_pl_cc = d.ma_pl_cc and d.status = 1' select @queryWhereClause = 'm.status = ''' + replace(rtrim(@$status), '''', '''''') + ''' and m.stt_rec not in (select stt_rec_gl from zcctdkts where ma_ct = ''CC1'')' if @unitCode <> '' select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + ' and m.ma_dvcs = ''' + replace(rtrim(@unitCode), '''', '''''') + '''' if @customer <> '' select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + case when @voucherCode = 'PXA' then ' and m.ma_kh' else ' and m.ma_kh_x' end + ' like ''' + replace(rtrim(@customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
if exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID) begin select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + ' and exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID and a.ma_kho = r.ma_kho)' end &FilterInitialize;&FilterQuery; declare @partitionKey nvarchar(4000), @l int, @firstItem varchar(128), @lastItem varchar(128) select @firstItem = @@firstItem, @lastItem = @@lastItem, @partitionKey = 'convert(char(8), m.ngay_ct, 112) + m.so_ct + m.stt_rec + replace(str(a.line_nbr, 5), '' '', ''0'')' select @l = 21 + character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'wrkcolumns' and column_name = 'so_ct'
if @firstItem <> '' set @firstItem = left(@firstItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@firstItem, len(@firstItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0') if @lastItem <> '' set @lastItem = left(@LastItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@lastItem, len(@lastItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0')
exec FastBusiness$Partition$ExecutePage @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @@textExternal, @queryFormClause, @queryWhereClause, @@textOrderBy, @partitionKey, 'm.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @unitCode, @@admin, @@userID
